$comment: Red-team queue floor: minimum concurrent starts when CPU idle meets the threshold. WE_RED_TEAM_QUEUE_MIN_CONCURRENT, WE_RED_TEAM_QUEUE_MIN_CONCURRENT_IDLE_PCT, and WE_RED_TEAM_QUEUE_REVIEW_STARTS_WHILE_IDLE override these values; file/env minimum concurrency and idle review starts are capped at 12; operator overrides can raise the capacity to 24. Instant leaves: redTeam.queue.cap, redTeam.queue.minConcurrentIdlePct, redTeam.queue.reviewStartsPerTickWhileIdle.
